description:
£175 PPPW - My Property Box are delighted to bring to the student lettings market this spacious seven-bedroom student property, ideally situated on the ever-popular Osborne Avenue in Jesmond.

Perfectly suited to student living, the property offers generous accommodation throughout, featuring a large kitchen, three bathrooms and double glazing throughout. The property also benefits from a private rear yard, providing a great outdoor space for tenants to enjoy.

Located in one of Jesmond-s most sought-after areas, the property is ideally positioned for students looking to enjoy the local amenities, popular bars, restaurants and excellent transport links, with convenient access to both Newcastle University and Northumbria University.

Don't miss out on this fantastic student property! Contact My Property Box today and speak to our Lettings Team to arrange your viewing.
